caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a bonnet predominantly colored in shades of light beige, cream, and soft yellow. The main object, located prominently on the left, is the bonnet shown in profile, adorned with ruffles, pleats, and a wide decorative ribbon that forms a large bow on the side, with two long ribbon ends hanging downward. The bonnet’s surface is covered in rows of pleated or gathered fabric separated by fine lines, and it is bordered by a frilled edge. Hanging strings extend from the inside bottom edge of the bonnet. On the right side of the drawing, there are two smaller line sketches of the same bonnet, one showing a rear view and the other a front or interior view. Both smaller sketches are rendered in grey pencil without color and display the arrangement of the bonnet’s bows, ruffles, and ties. The background of the entire image is plain and neutral, leaving the focus on the bonnet and its design elements.
title: Bonnet
